content:
jess (Support): heads up — AcmePayments reported canary rollout health chart stuck in 'in progress' for ~3h, but their rollout finished on infra side. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/rollout-stuck.png :eyes:

maria (Support): created SUP-4321, customer on a call now. they say logs show rollout completed and new pods are Ready. can we escalate?

sam (oncall): assigning to eng-runtime, pinging @alex for triage.

alex (eng-runtime): I'll take a look. can you paste the rollout id and the API response for /v1/rollouts/{id}/status?

jess (Support): rollout id r_5f7e2, project acme-payments, cluster eu-west-1. API shows healthy:

```
\curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/r_5f7e2/status | jq .
{
  "id": "r_5f7e2",
  "status": "Healthy",
  "updated_at": "2026-03-15T11:08:22Z"
}
```

alex (eng-runtime): interesting — control plane reports healthy. console chart is likely showing stale status from the rollout-status-syncer. i'll check syncer logs for r_5f7e2.

sync-service-bot: log tail for rollout-status-syncer (prod):

```
2026-03-15T12:09:58Z ERROR syncer.go:172 error listing Rollouts: Unauthorized: token expired
2026-03-15T12:10:02Z WARN backoff.go:47 backoff triggered: next attempt in 5m
2026-03-15T12:15:02Z ERROR syncer.go:172 error listing Rollouts: Unauthorized: token rotated, refresh failed
```

alex (eng-runtime): looks like the syncer hit an auth failure while listing rollout CRs and entered exponential backoff. it didn't backfill statuses after the control-plane update. that's why console shows 'in progress'.

sam (oncall): can we do a quick workaround for the customer?

alex (eng-runtime): yes — two options:
1) Restart the rollout-status-syncer pod to force immediate resync (quick but manual).
2) Call admin backfill endpoint to re-sync a specific rollout:

```
POST https://console.redwood.ai/admin/sync/rollouts?r=r_5f7e2
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
```

I recommend restarting first to get all affected rollouts patched.

maria (Support): sent the workaround to customer, they asked for ETA.

deploy-bot: restart triggered: deployment/rollout-status-syncer -> rolling restart (prod) by sam at 2026-03-15T12:23:10Z :rocket:

sync-service-bot: restart succeeded. syncer backfilled 14 rollouts, last_synced=2026-03-15T12:24:03Z

alex (eng-runtime): after restart the console queried control plane and updated states. r_5f7e2 now shows Healthy in UI. I pushed a small telemetry patch to log token refresh failures more verbosely (PR: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-runtime/pulls/879). Canaries scheduled to 10% then 50%.

toni (product): good. please confirm customer messaging: recommend telling Acme that we performed an internal restart and that charts should reflect the correct state; they can refresh.

maria (Support): told Acme the restart was done, they refreshed the page and confirmed chart moved to Healthy. they've accepted the status and won't need rollback.

alex (eng-runtime): postmortem notes / action items:
- ENG-RUNTIME-879: add retry on token refresh + alert when syncer fails to list CRs (owner: alex)
- add integration test to simulate token rotation and ensure backfill path triggers (owner: qa)
- add a small admin endpoint to trigger forced resync per-rollout (owner: eng-platform)

jess (Support): leaving follow-up in SUP-4321 referencing ENG-RUNTIME-879, customer ok with current state, monitoring for 24h. closing after confirmation.

sam (oncall): monitoring metrics: console-api errors spiked at 12:09-12:20 UTC — create dashboard panel to track `syncer.list_rollouts_errors` and `syncer.backoff_count`.

alex (eng-runtime): rolling patch to syncer canary started at 2026-03-15T13:00:00Z, will promote after 30m if no errors.

maria (Support): customer will email if anything else. marking thread for follow-up tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

jess (Support): thanks team, good quick remediation. closing internal alert once canary is healthy.

sync-service-bot: summary: 14 rollouts updated, 1 on-call restart performed, follow-up ticket ENG-RUNTIME-879 opened.
